recent_posts.title: Former GTA Developer Obbe Vermeij Releases His Nature Sandbox Game
recent_posts.summary: Former Rockstar Technical Director Obbe Vermeij has released Plentiful, a nature god sandbox game, into early access on Steam after three years of development. Players shape terrain, manage water flow, grow food, support wildlife, and keep tribes alive across 20+ levels. The game features dynamic seasons, a day/night cycle, natural disasters, a built-in level editor, and Steam Workshop support for community content.

recent_posts.title: Building a Procedural Destruction Pipeline with Houdini & UE5
recent_posts.summary: A detailed breakdown of a procedural destruction pipeline called PROJECT MAYHEM that bridges Houdini and Unreal Engine 5. The workflow covers Houdini Digital Asset (HDA) cutter logic combining Voronoi and Boolean fracture, custom geometry collection attributes for Chaos system integration, Blueprint-driven weapon interaction, Niagara VFX with Data Channels for performant particle effects, and Dataflow graphs for non-destructive fracture authoring. The pipeline also includes internal material generation using baked thickness, curvature, and AO data packed into RGB masks for visually consistent fracture surfaces.

recent_posts.title: Stylized Grass Shader for Unity
recent_posts.summary: Staggart Creations has released a Stylized Grass Shader for Unity, compatible with URP 17+ and Unity 6. The shader features wind animations with dynamic speed and direction, an interaction system for bending and flattening grass via trails, meshes, and particle effects, hue variation, terrain blending, and physically-based or simple shading modes. It supports SRP Batching and GPU Resident Drawer, runs on PC, macOS, and consoles, and is optimized with a hand-written shader. Users migrating from pre-Unity 6 versions receive a 20% discount.

recent_posts.title: Sony Animator Shows Endearing References for an Opening Scene in GOAT
recent_posts.summary: Saul Latorre Sebastian, Lead Animator at Sony Pictures Imageworks, shared behind-the-scenes reference footage he filmed with his own mother for the opening scene of the animated film GOAT. The scene depicts the main character attending a sports match with his mom as a child, and Latorre Sebastian described it as the longest shot he has worked on and one of the most personally meaningful. GOAT, released in February, follows a young goat named Will Harris pursuing his dream of playing roarball, a basketball-inspired sport, in a world of anthropomorphic animals.

recent_posts.title: Unity Dev Open-Sources UI Toolkit Design System Used In Game
recent_posts.summary: Solo developer Sinan Ata has open-sourced a production-ready UI Toolkit Design System built on Unity 6's UI Toolkit, used in his multiplayer game Leap of Legends. Released under the MIT license, the system provides design tokens, reusable components, icons, mobile support, and a runtime helper — all controlled from a single stylesheet with a dark theme. It addresses the lack of a built-in design language in Unity's UI Toolkit, where teams typically rebuild common UI elements inconsistently. The system can be integrated by dropping a folder into the Assets directory. Sinan reports significant productivity gains: menu screens go from design to shipped in hours rather than days, mobile parity is handled with a single class, and cross-screen consistency is automatic.

recent_posts.title: Artist Shows WIP Unity Vertex Painter Tool
recent_posts.summary: Mojang Senior Technical Artist Brendan 'Sully' Sullivan is developing a custom Unity Vertex Painter tool that lets artists paint vertex data directly onto meshes inside the Unity editor. He shared progress updates including a review of ~5,000 lines of code, documentation writing, and Asset Store preparation, demonstrated with a Nintendo 64-style retro scene. The tool is not yet released but is being prepared for the Unity Asset Store.

recent_posts.title: New Xbox CEO Stops Development of Copilot on Consoles
recent_posts.summary: New Xbox CEO Asha Sharma is canceling Copilot on consoles and winding down Copilot on mobile as part of a broader leadership restructuring. Sharma, who replaced Phil Spencer, is bringing in four employees from Microsoft's CoreAI division to help Xbox move faster and better serve players and developers. Key leadership changes include Jason Ronald taking responsibility for Project Helix (the next Xbox console), Jared Palmer focusing on developer tooling and game submission infrastructure, and several other new roles aimed at simplifying development and driving growth.

recent_posts.title: 3D Artist Explains Importance Of Lighting
recent_posts.summary: 3D artist Yon Lee shares her approach to lighting in 3D art, explaining why it matters beyond just visibility. She covers her go-to three-point lighting setup (fill, key, and rim lights), the importance of value separation and visual hierarchy, and how lighting affects material readability. Practical tips include starting with a balanced fill light, using a key light to direct attention, and adding rim lighting to separate subjects from backgrounds. The post includes before/after comparisons showing how lighting changes alone can dramatically improve a render's quality.

recent_posts.title: Create Winding Rivers & Roaring Oceans in Unity URP with AQUIS Pro
recent_posts.summary: AureDevGames has released AQUIS Pro, a Unity URP asset that provides a complete water simulation solution. It features a spline-based mesh generator for creating rivers and oceans, a customizable water shader, and a flow map creator. Key capabilities include terrain-aligned water meshes, automatic or hand-painted flow maps, dynamic foam, caustics, underwater distortion with depth-based color absorption, and support for real-time and baked lighting. Available on the Unity Asset Store with a template scene included.

recent_posts.title: GameStop CEO dodges funding questions in CNBC interview about eBay acquisition bid
recent_posts.summary: GameStop CEO Ryan Cohen appeared on CNBC to discuss the company's proposed $55.5 billion acquisition of eBay but repeatedly dodged questions about how GameStop — with a market cap of $10.8 billion and roughly $9 billion in stock — plans to fund the deal. Even with TD Securities' $20 billion commitment, a $16 billion gap remains unexplained. Cohen deflected questions, told the reporter to read the press release, and ultimately claimed not to understand the question, leaving the funding mystery unresolved.
